name: Soft Gingerbread

instructions.text: Beat to a cream half a pound of fresh butter cut up in a deep pan, among half a pound of brown sugar, setting it near the fire to soften it a little, but not to melt it
Add two large table-spoonfuls of ginger, a tea-spoonful of powdered cinnamon, and a tea-spoonful of powdered cloves
Stir into it, alternately, a pint of West India molasses, and three pints of sifted flour, and six well-beaten eggs
Dissolve a small tea-spoonful of pearl-ash in a pint of sour milk, and stir it, while foaming, into the mixture
Put it immediately into shallow square tin pans, well buttered
Place it in an oven not too hot
Bake, giving it long beating and much baking

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat to a cream half a pound of fresh butter cut up in a deep pan, among half a pound of brown sugar, setting it near the fire to soften it a little, but not to melt it
2. Add two large table-spoonfuls of ginger, a tea-spoonful of powdered cinnamon, and a tea-spoonful of powdered cloves
3. Stir into it, alternately, a pint of West India molasses, and three pints of sifted flour, and six well-beaten eggs
4. Dissolve a small tea-spoonful of pearl-ash in a pint of sour milk, and stir it, while foaming, into the mixture
5. Put it immediately into shallow square tin pans, well buttered
6. Place it in an oven not too hot
7. Bake, giving it long beating and much baking
